assertions.title: Load transitions show visible loading and settle cleanly

steps.action: Open the dashboard at /index.html and wait for the page to settle
steps.expected: A visible loading state appears during the transition and then disappears so the page settles into a clean loaded state
steps.observed: The page showed the loading banner 'Fetching latest data from Google Sheets…' at the same time as fully rendered summary metrics, goal cards, filters, and table rows

steps.expected: Loaded content should not retain loading UI once the dashboard is available
steps.observed: The loading affordance lingered in the settled overview instead of clearing

evidence.network: No additional requests were needed for the settled-state capture; the visible issue was a mixed loading+loaded UI on the live page

assertions.issues: The dashboard does not settle cleanly after load because the loading banner remains visible alongside loaded content.

assertions.title: Dashboard interactions do not create app-history navigation

steps.action: From the loaded dashboard, scope to goal 3 and enter 'Wyoming' in search
steps.expected: These in-dashboard interactions should not create history/navigation semantics for the dashboard view
steps.observed: The URL stayed at http://127.0.0.1:3100/index.html while the page narrowed to one result

steps.action: Press browser Back and then Forward
steps.expected: Back/Forward should be a no-op for dashboard interactions rather than leaving the app surface
steps.observed: Back navigated to about:blank, and Forward restored the dashboard at http://127.0.0.1:3100/index.html

evidence.network: Forward reloaded the local dashboard document at http://127.0.0.1:3100/index.html

assertions.issues: Browser history is not inert for dashboard interactions because Back leaves the app to about:blank before Forward returns.

assertions.title: Stale goal semantics are unambiguous in the UI

steps.action: Patch fetch in the browser page to return a custom CSV where goal 1 rows are dated 2026-03-20 and goal 4 has a fresh 2026-04-08 row, then trigger Refresh
steps.expected: Visible stale treatment and text should communicate the chosen recency rule without conflicting age signals
steps.observed: The page header showed 'Live · current (0d old)' while goal 1 simultaneously showed 'Blocked: Ada' and 'Stale (> 7d)'

steps.action: Review the summary, goal cards, and blocked section in the refreshed custom-data state
steps.expected: Age messaging should remain semantically consistent across the screen
steps.observed: The page-level freshness read as fresh/current even though a visible goal card on the same screen was marked stale

evidence.network: Refresh used browser-surface fetch patching for the Google Sheets request to simulate the stale/fresh mixed dataset

assertions.issues: The UI still presents conflicting recency semantics by mixing a fresh global label with a stale goal card on the same screen.

assertions.title: Error and recovery transitions stay recoverable and non-misleading

steps.action: From the custom-data browser state, patch fetch in-page to throw for the Google Sheets request and press Refresh
steps.expected: Refresh failure should stay on the same page with a recoverable status surface and avoid broken or misleading mixed presentations
steps.observed: The page showed an in-place error surface with 'Could not load data' and 'Try again', but it also continued to display the previous summary, goal cards, blocked section, controls, and table content underneath

steps.action: Restore fetch and press Try again to recover
steps.expected: Retry should settle into a clean loaded state without duplicate or lingering status UI
steps.observed: Retry restored loaded content, but the loading banner 'Fetching latest data from Google Sheets…' remained visible over the settled dashboard

evidence.network: Failure and recovery were exercised through browser-page fetch patching for the Google Sheets request

assertions.issues: The transitions remain misleading because refresh failure overlays stale prior content and retry recovery still leaves a lingering loading banner in the settled state.

assertions.title: Refresh preserves a coherent scoped or filtered state

steps.action: Start from overview, scope to goal 3, enter search text 'Wyoming', and capture the narrowed state
steps.expected: The narrowed state should be coherent before refresh
steps.observed: The page narrowed to one visible Biz Dev result with the scope indicator and search state applied

steps.action: Press Refresh and wait for the page to settle
steps.expected: After reload completion the scoped/filtered state should remain coherent with no orphaned loading UI, stale expansion UI, or broken controls
steps.observed: The search result, scope indicator, filters, and controls remained coherent, but the loading banner persisted above the settled dashboard content

evidence.network: Observed repeated GET requests to the Google Sheets CSV endpoint during refresh while the URL stayed http://127.0.0.1:3100/index.html

assertions.issues: Refresh preserves the narrowed subset, but the post-refresh state is still incoherent because the loading UI remains visible after content has settled.

frictions.description: The prior scoped/search state carried into the first custom-data run, so the custom stale-semantics check initially inherited an irrelevant scope and had to be reset before capturing final evidence.
frictions.resolution: Used the in-page reset control to clear the inherited narrowing state, then reran the browser-only fetch-patched scenario from a clean overview.

summary: Retested 5 assigned assertions and all 5 still fail. The dashboard still leaves loading UI visible after load/refresh, browser Back leaves the app surface, stale goal semantics remain contradictory in mixed-recency data, and refresh failure/recovery transitions still produce misleading mixed states.
